item.title: School Dismissals, Murder Probe, Newborn Death
item.ns0:title: School Dismissals, Murder Probe, Newborn Death
item.description:
Tonight on Our News, health concerns, power outages, and water supply issues force early dismissals and temporary closures at several schools across New Providence. Meanwhile, police launch a murder investigation after a fatal shooting on Rupert Dean Lane, while a trainee correctional officer is arrested after drugs were found hidden inside his work boots. Plus, Governor General Dame Cynthia "Mother" Pratt celebrates the inspiring launch of her new autobiography at the University of The Bahamas, and the government unveils a new Young Innovators Club for students. Tune in for all these top headlines, key financial updates for local consumers, local sports, and your full holiday weekend weather forecast.
